title: What a Data Release Must Preserve for Off-Policy Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15283v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In off-policy evaluation, merging decision-time histories that matter differently for a specified policy value or comparison can make that evaluation unidentified, even with observed actions and outcomes and known behavior and target policies. We characterize which distinctions must be preserved: identification holds if and only if the action-specific evaluation weights are constant within each released record, and the coarsest exact release groups histories by these weights. For normalized outcomes, the largest sharp width induced by the release equals a behavior-weighted within-record radius of these weights. The same radius becomes a release-design objective when each record may be refined into at most $m$ categories. The optimum has an exact $m$-center characterization. translated_title: 策略外评估中数据发布必须保留什么
translated_abstract: 在策略外评估中，若将对特定策略价值或比较具有不同重要性的决策时历史记录合并在一起，可能会使该评估变得不可识别，即使已观测到动作和结果，且行为策略和目标策略均已知。我们刻画了必须保留哪些区分：识别性成立当且仅当动作特定的评估权重在每个发布记录内保持恒定，而最粗的精确发布正是按这些权重对历史进行分组。对于归一化结果，发布所诱导的最大锐宽度等于这些权重的行为加权记录内半径。当每个记录最多可细化为 $m$ 个类别时，同样的半径成为发布设计目标，且最优解具有精确的 $m$ 中心刻画。当行为在发布记录内不发生变化时，我们给出了一个有限数据修复算法，其最大评估权重半径至多是有限数据最优值的……
tldr: 本文刻画了策略外评估中数据发布必须保留的关键信息——识别性当且仅当动作特定评估权重在每个发布记录内恒定时成立——并据此提出以权重半径为目标的发布设计方法与有限数据修复算法。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes what data releases must preserve for off-policy evaluation—identification holds if and only if action-specific evaluation weights are constant within each released record—and derives weight-radius-based release design objectives and a finite-data repair algorithm.
